proposed_resolution: The default now uses the authoritative expanded file and a regression test reproduces 61 overlap and 97 non-overlap issuers.

proposed_resolution: A blank 94-case human-confirmation packet and adjudication template exist; no intercoder or human-validation statistic can be estimated until a human freezes independent decisions.

issue: The 61/61 result is selected-overlap concordance rather than target-population precision; recall, calibration, and four-class error are unidentified.
proposed_resolution: The proposed frame remains incomplete and no random draw has occurred; approve a probability design and obtain independent human labels before estimating error rates.

issue: The broad novelty claim is contradicted by prior LGFV transformation, regulatory decoupling, and text-measurement research.
proposed_resolution: The manuscript and bibliography now claim the LGFV-specific joint evidence design rather than priority for the formal-substantive distinction.

issue: The adjusted historical-capacity result has 12 events, complete-case selection, rank deficiency, and high case-deletion sensitivity.
proposed_resolution: The reference-category repair removes the alias, but sparse events, selective missingness, and 9 LPM plus 11 Firth sign changes keep the adjusted claim unstable.

issue: The evidence inventory is traceable, but one gold case lacks local copies and 32 cases lack an exact dedicated-memo match.
proposed_resolution: Recover or document the two Changshu files and create memo-equivalent audit records for the remaining cases; keep reconstruction separate from label validation.

issue: The compiled paper is 89 pages and the main text is about 37 pages, with several table-layout warnings and colored link boxes.
proposed_resolution: The revision has 25 main-text pages, 80 pages including the source appendix and references, hidden link borders, and no visually observed clipping.

issue: The current full-control design includes an intercept and two exhaustive platform-category dummies, so its nine columns have rank eight.
proposed_resolution: The corrected model uses district-and-county platforms as the reference and has eight columns with rank eight; sparse-outcome concerns remain under R-006.

proposed_resolution: Source retrieval resolves 40 of the 128 incomplete geographies, but 88 remain unresolved, 98 require scope review, and only four packet-ready candidate issuers pass current gates.

proposed_resolution: PI selects and prospectively tests a location policy or excludes the nonunique unit; coordinator independently reviews the three existing-rule findings and executes EXP-20260831-004 before any freeze or draw.

issue: Follow-up to R-010 and R-011: geography and scope completion require a reproducible approved-rule integration with verified current citations.
proposed_resolution: All 98 scope reviews resolved; 87 of 88 baseline geography gaps uniquely assigned; one already-ineligible commercial issuer retains multiple geography under PI-approved rule. Current 67-unit candidate passes source and deterministic checks; freeze approval and human labels remain separate.

issue: The historical Shenzhen SASAC raw page is unavailable and its inherited owner excerpt quoted navigation rather than focal-company evidence.
proposed_resolution: Retained old source and failed recovery; appended dated current official profile with direct issuer evidence and corrected current publication metadata; every other decision and source row unchanged. Current evidence verified and locally archived.

issue: Mutable source expectations and incomplete origin-field comparisons could let invalid scientific metadata pass while preserving totals.
proposed_resolution: Independent canonical fixtures, exact baseline manifest and complete origin/candidate/design comparisons, protected-label mutation tests, and raw Guiyang extraction checks pass independent AI review.

issue: Follow-up to R-003: the author now reports that all 94 reference labels were checked by a human without revision.
proposed_resolution: Record the completed human checking in the case-level register and manuscript while retaining the original AI-production snapshot. This closes the absence-of-human-check report, not the separate requirement for documented blind reliability.

issue: Author-reported checking of all reference cases does not provide reviewer identity, actual review dates, or independent blinded decisions needed to document intercoder reliability.
proposed_resolution: Preserve the report without inventing metadata; obtain individual decisions and review-process documentation before estimating or claiming blinded intercoder reliability.
